tinker.name: Resume
tinker.description: Fill in resume details, pick a template, and export PDF

zh-CN.name: 简历
zh-CN.description: 填写个人信息、选择模板并导出 PDF

get.description: Get the current resume JSON, template id (classic or sidebar), and accent themeColor. Call this before editing.

set.description: Update the live resume. Provide resume to replace the document, and/or templateId, and/or themeColor. Changes apply immediately in the preview. Call get first if you need current values. Call export_pdf afterward to write a PDF.

resume.description: Full resume document: basic, skillContent, selfEvaluationContent, experience, projects, education, certificates, menuSections

export_pdf.description: Export the current resume preview to a PDF file. Same as the toolbar export, but path is required (no save dialog). Call set first if updating the resume.

path.description: Absolute path to save the PDF
